sloka: बाढमित्येव तं राम दशग्रीवो ऽभ्यभाषत ।प्रज्चाल्य तत्र चैवाग्निमकरोत्पाणिसङ्ग्रहम् ।। ७.१२.१९ ॥
transliteration: bāḍhamityeva taṁ rāma daśagrīvo 'bhyabhāṣata ।prajcālya tatra caivāgnimakarotpāṇisaṅgraham ।। 7.12.19 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, Dashagriva indeed said "Agreed" to him, and having kindled a fire there, he performed the marriage ceremony.
